_comment: 投資想法與查核點。早報事件判斷層每天讀這份（https://research.investmquest.com/ideas/ideas.json），把判成新事實的新聞比對到查核點，再問 Jev 支持／推翻／無關，結果寫到 /briefing/data/idea_hits.json。companies 用早報 evidence_routing 的公司代號，對照表認不得的公司另列英文名在 company_names；keywords 是英文新聞裡的辨識詞（小寫比對）；supports_if／refutes_if 是給 Jev 的英文判準，要寫成新聞字面上看得出來的事。 due 是查核點的到期事件（approx=true 表示日期是依往年推估、公司尚未公告），早報在到期前 7 天提醒。 keystone=true 是關鍵查核點：狀態轉為推翻時整篇重新評估，另寄提醒信。

ideas.title: AI 剪刀差：token 越來越便宜，算力、電力、記憶體越來越貴

checkpoints.label: AI 營收成長跑贏降價（營收＝用量×單價）
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports AI revenue (OpenAI or Anthropic annualized revenue, Azure AI, Google Cloud AI) or total AI token usage still growing strongly despite model price cuts. A single data point (one month's revenue, one price quote) without a stated trend or guidance change is not enough: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports AI model or cloud AI revenue slowing or falling as prices drop, or total token usage flattening. A single data point (one month's revenue, one price quote) without a stated trend or guidance change is not enough: answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: GPU 雲同代旗艦租金與長約價格守住
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports current-generation flagship GPU (B200, B300, GB300, Rubin) rental prices or per-megawatt contract prices, especially long-term contracts, rising or holding firm.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports current-generation GPU rental prices or long-term per-megawatt contract prices falling. Price declines of older GPUs such as H100 after newer chips launch are normal and do not count: answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: 記憶體季度合約價續漲，供應商財測上修
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports quarterly DRAM or HBM contract prices rising (for example TrendForce contract price reports), or memory makers raising guidance or long-term contract prices. Spot price moves alone are not enough: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports quarterly DRAM or HBM contract prices falling, or memory makers guiding lower. Spot price moves alone are not enough: answer unrelated.

due.label: SK 海力士第三季財報

checkpoints.label: 發電與電網設備交期繼續拉長
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports power equipment (turbines, transformers, grid gear) backlogs growing, lead times lengthening, or data center projects delayed by power or grid access.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports power equipment lead times shortening, backlogs shrinking, or order cancellations.

checkpoints.label: 四大雲廠資本支出上修
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports a hyperscaler raising or maintaining high AI or data center capital spending plans.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports a hyperscaler cutting its capital spending guidance or explicitly saying it will slow AI or data center spending. Holding spending flat at a high level does not count.

checkpoints.label: 資料中心融資還借得到錢
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports data center or AI cloud financing being raised successfully, loans trading near par, or IPOs well received.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports data center or AI cloud loans trading at a discount, credit downgrades, financing pulled, IPOs delayed, or projects mothballed.

checkpoints.label: 伺服器 CPU 供不應求（看 Intel、AMD 自己的說法）
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports Intel, AMD, or Arm-based server CPU vendors saying demand exceeds supply, or raising server CPU prices.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports Intel or AMD saying server CPU supply is catching up with demand, or cutting server CPU prices.

checkpoints.label: 台積電財測、CoWoS 產能與晶圓漲價
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports TSMC raising guidance, raising wafer prices, or advanced packaging (CoWoS) demand exceeding capacity. A single data point (one month's revenue, one price quote) without a stated trend or guidance change is not enough: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports TSMC lowering guidance, customers cutting orders, or CoWoS capacity growing fast enough that AI chips are no longer scarce. A single data point (one month's revenue, one price quote) without a stated trend or guidance change is not enough: answer unrelated.

due.label: 台積電 9 月營收（只當提醒，看趨勢）
台積電 10 月營收（只當提醒，看趨勢）

checkpoints.label: 伺服器台數：信驊營收看三個月平均年增
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports Aspeed (BMC chips, one per server) revenue growth accelerating over several months or a quarter, or server shipment forecasts being raised. A single data point (one month's revenue, one price quote) without a stated trend or guidance change is not enough: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports Aspeed's multi-month or quarterly revenue growth turning negative, or server shipment forecasts being cut. A single data point (one month's revenue, one price quote) without a stated trend or guidance change is not enough: answer unrelated.

due.label: 信驊 9 月營收（看三個月平均）
信驊 10 月營收（看三個月平均）

ideas.title: 消費級代理人大戰：誰擁有代理人還沒定，驗證、付款與算力三層先受惠

checkpoints.label: 用戶真的每天用代理人：各家合計的使用量與留存
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports consumer AI agents (Meta Muse, Apple Siri, Google Gemini agent, Amazon Alexa+, OpenAI, Instinct) gaining or holding daily active users, retention, or paying subscribers after the launch spike.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports consumer AI agent daily usage or retention falling for months without stabilizing, or providers cutting free tiers because usage is low. A normal decline right after a launch spike is not enough: answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: 代理人真的完成交易：商家開放與代理人訂單
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports more merchants opening checkout to AI agents, or disclosed orders, sales, or transaction volume coming through AI agents.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports merchants saying AI agent orders are negligible, merchants withdrawing agent integrations, or an agent provider scaling back in-agent purchasing (as OpenAI did with ChatGPT Instant Checkout).

checkpoints.label: 情境：Muse 能不能守住領先（只影響 Meta 那一段）
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports Meta Muse keeping its lead in usage, rankings, or merchant integrations after rivals (new Siri, Gemini, Alexa+, OpenAI, Instinct) launch or upgrade their agents.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports a rival consumer agent overtaking Muse in usage, rankings, or merchant integrations, or Muse usage dropping after a rival launch.

checkpoints.label: 代理人抽成守不守得住
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports Meta or another consumer agent provider earning merchant transaction fees or commissions at a stable rate.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports agent providers cutting fees, offering free merchant integration because of competition, or delaying fee plans.

checkpoints.label: 身分驗證變成基本配備
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports AI agents adopting cryptographic identity, growth in agent or bot management traffic or revenue, or courts treating user-directed agents as the user.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports courts or new laws letting websites legally bar AI agents, or large sites handling agents entirely in-house without third-party tools.

checkpoints.label: 付款層：協議整合與出錯責任
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports card networks or payment companies launching or expanding AI agent payments, clearer liability rules, or intermediaries supporting several agent payment protocols.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports AI agent payment fraud or errors causing payment companies to pull back, or an agent provider building payments that bypass card networks.

checkpoints.label: 手機作業系統對第三方代理人的態度
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports Apple or Google allowing third-party AI agents to act for users on their platforms.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports Apple or Google restricting third-party AI agents or reserving agent permissions for their own Siri or Gemini.

checkpoints.label: 靠廣告和流量的平台受壓（只算明講或第三方數據）
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports AI agents diverting shopping or search traffic away from ad-funded platforms with explicit attribution, or platforms blocking agents to protect ads.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports ad-funded platforms saying AI agents have not affected traffic or ads, or agents carrying ads to users. Ad revenue changes without a stated link to AI agents do not count: answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: 伺服器 CPU：代理人的錢流向誰
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports AMD or Intel citing AI agent demand for server CPUs, server CPU price increases holding, or large deployments of new EPYC or Xeon CPUs for agent workloads.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports AMD or Intel saying server CPU supply is catching up or cutting prices, or agent workloads moving mostly to cloud providers' in-house chips with x86 server revenue slowing.

ideas.title: 中國晶片自給：國家怎麼推、推到哪、卡在哪

checkpoints.label: 中國 EUV 做出能用的晶片
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports China's domestically built EUV lithography machine producing working chips, entering trial production at a fab, or clearing a major component milestone (light source power, mirror reflectivity, mask blanks or mask inspection) confirmed by credible reporting or officials. Executive predictions alone without new evidence of progress: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports China's EUV project being delayed, failing on key components such as optics, light source, mask blanks or mask inspection, or missing its 2028 target for working chips.

checkpoints.label: 外國設備商的中國營收：金額與公司說法
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports a chip equipment maker (ASML, Applied Materials, Lam Research, KLA, Tokyo Electron) saying Chinese customers are switching to domestic Chinese tools, or its China revenue declining year over year in dollar terms for consecutive quarters with the company attributing it to local competition. A decline attributed only to export controls or shipment timing is not enough: answer unrelated. A change in China's share of revenue without the dollar amounts is not enough: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports a chip equipment maker's China revenue growing year over year in dollar terms at least as fast as its non-China revenue, or the company stating that Chinese domestic tools are not displacing its products. A rise in China's share of revenue without the dollar amounts is not enough: answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: 中國本土 AI 晶片放量：昇騰產量、中芯先進產能與良率
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports rising production or shipments of Huawei Ascend or other Chinese AI chips, SMIC expanding advanced-node (7nm or 5nm-class) capacity or improving advanced-node yield, or Chinese AI labs training major models on domestic chips.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports Huawei Ascend output or SMIC advanced-node yield or capacity falling short, or Chinese AI labs and cloud companies switching back to Nvidia chips because domestic chips or software fall short.

checkpoints.label: 美國出口管制往哪走（含海外租用）
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports the US loosening AI chip or chipmaking tool sales to China, Chinese companies continuing to use Nvidia chips through overseas data centers or smuggling without effective enforcement, or US officials acknowledging that export controls cannot stop China from building its own advanced chipmaking tools.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports the US, alone or with the Netherlands, Japan or Germany, tightening controls on AI chips, HBM, lithography components, servicing, or Chinese companies' access to overseas data centers, with reporting that China's progress is delayed as a result.

due.label: BIS 附屬企業規則暫停期滿、自動恢復

checkpoints.label: 國產浸潤式 DUV 進入量產線
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports a Chinese-made immersion DUV lithography tool entering volume production lines at a Chinese fab or shipping in volume, or ASML saying its China DUV orders are falling because of local competition.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports Chinese-made immersion DUV tools failing qualification or being delayed, or Chinese fabs continuing to buy ASML DUV tools in large volume with ASML saying it sees no domestic competition.

checkpoints.label: 輝達在中國賣不賣得回去
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports Nvidia's China revenue staying near zero even after export licenses were granted, Chinese regulators telling companies to stop buying Nvidia chips, or Chinese customers saying they are switching to domestic chips.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports Nvidia's China revenue recovering materially, or Chinese customers placing large orders for licensed Nvidia chips.

checkpoints.label: 中國自製 HBM 量產（長鑫 HBM3E）
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports CXMT or another Chinese memory maker starting mass production of HBM3 or HBM3E, passing qualification with Huawei or other Chinese AI chip makers, or materially raising HBM yield or output.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports CXMT's HBM3 or HBM3E mass production being delayed, failing customer qualification, or suffering low yield.

checkpoints.label: 中國設備自給率與國產設備商營收（北方華創、中微、新廠五成國產規定）
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports China's chip equipment self-sufficiency rate rising, Chinese toolmakers such as Naura or AMEC posting strong revenue growth or winning large orders at SMIC or other fabs, or China's rule that new fabs use at least half domestic equipment being enforced more strictly or extended to advanced nodes.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports China's equipment self-sufficiency stalling, Naura or AMEC revenue falling, domestic tools failing qualification on production lines, or the domestic-equipment rule being relaxed.

ideas.title: 債市在定價什麼：高實質利率、期限溢價，與一場還沒被定價的分化

checkpoints.label: 長端漲是期限溢價在推：Fed 升息預期降，長債殖利率不降
checkpoints.cadence: 隨時（11 月初財政部再融資公告）
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports long-term US Treasury yields (10-year or 30-year) rising or holding near highs while expectations for near-term Fed rate hikes fall or oil prices fall, or explicitly attributes the rise in long yields to term premium, deficits, Treasury supply, larger coupon auctions or weak long-bond auction demand. A single-day yield move without such attribution is not enough: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports oil prices falling on Middle East de-escalation with the 10-year Treasury yield falling below 4.8% alongside, and analysts attributing the earlier rise in long yields to oil or war risk rather than fiscal or supply concerns; or term premium estimates falling back as yields drop.

due.label: 美國財政部季度再融資公告

checkpoints.label: 高收益債利差：30 天走寬是否超過 75bp
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports US high-yield (junk) bond spreads stable or tightening, strong high-yield issuance, or stable default rates.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports US high-yield (junk) bond spreads widening sharply, about 0.75 percentage point or more within roughly a month, or rising above 4%; or a wave of high-yield defaults or downgrades, or the junk bond issuance market shutting down. A one-day move without a trend: answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: 就業：非農三個月平均與失業率
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports US nonfarm payroll growth whose three-month average stays positive and an unemployment rate at or below 4.3%.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports US nonfarm payrolls turning negative with revisions pushing the three-month average below zero, or the unemployment rate rising to 4.4% or higher. A single month's figure without trend or revision context: answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: Fed 路徑：10/28 與 12/9 FOMC，以及長端怎麼反應
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports the Fed raising rates or signaling a December hike while long-term Treasury yields hold or rise, or FOMC minutes or statements stressing oil-driven inflation risk with no discussion of rate cuts.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports the Fed turning to rate cuts or ending its tightening because of a weakening labor market, or the Fed holding rates in December while long-term Treasury yields still rise.

checkpoints.label: 核心通膨：核心 CPI 是否連兩個月月增 0.2% 以下
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports US core CPI or core PCE rising 0.3% or more month over month, or core inflation staying near 3% year over year.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports US core CPI rising 0.2% or less month over month for a second consecutive month, alongside falling energy prices. A single month's figure without trend context: answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: 油價：布蘭特是否持續回落到 85 美元以下
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports Brent crude holding around or above $90 a barrel because of Middle East supply risk.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports Brent crude falling and staying below $85 a barrel for weeks on Middle East de-escalation or higher supply. A one-day drop: answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: 廣度：10 年期 5% 以上時，等權重 S&P 500 能否創新高
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports narrow market breadth, with the equal-weight S&P 500 or the Russell 2000 lagging the cap-weighted S&P 500 while Treasury yields stay high.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports the equal-weight S&P 500 (RSP) hitting a record high while the 10-year Treasury yield remains at or above 5%.

ideas.title: Marvell 2030 目標：FY28 的 200 億看得到，FY29 以後押在客製翻三倍與 scale-up 光學

checkpoints.label: FY29 客製營收逾 120 億：公司說法與大專案量產
checkpoints.cadence: 每季（下次財報約 12 月初）
checkpoints.supports_if: Marvell management reiterates or raises its target of more than $12 billion in custom revenue for fiscal 2029 (more than triple fiscal 2028), confirms custom revenue more than doubling in fiscal 2028, or says a new hyperscaler XPU program or Google TPU-related attach programs entered volume production on schedule. Analyst estimates or supply-chain reports without a statement from Marvell or the customer: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: Marvell management cuts its fiscal 2029 custom revenue target below $10 billion or to less than double fiscal 2028, says fiscal 2028 custom revenue will less than double, or discloses that a major XPU or XPU attach program was delayed, cancelled or lost. If Marvell lowers the target but keeps it between $10 billion and $12 billion, or between two and three times fiscal 2028, answer shaky. Analyst estimates or supply-chain reports without a statement from Marvell or the customer: answer unrelated.

due.label: Marvell 第四季財報與 FY28 展望

checkpoints.label: FY28 營收約 200 億：財測維持、上調還是下修
checkpoints.cadence: 每季（下次財報約 12 月初）
checkpoints.supports_if: Marvell reports quarterly results and keeps or raises its fiscal 2028 revenue outlook of about $20 billion, or its outlook for about 80% data center revenue growth in fiscal 2028. A quarterly beat or miss against analyst estimates with no change to the company's own outlook: answer neutral.
checkpoints.refutes_if: Marvell lowers its fiscal 2028 revenue outlook below about $20 billion, lowers its fiscal 2028 data center growth outlook, or guides next-quarter revenue below the current quarter. Analyst estimate cuts without a company statement: answer unrelated.

due.label: Marvell 第四季財報與 FY28 展望

checkpoints.label: 首席 XPU 的下一代由誰設計（AWS Trainium）
checkpoints.cadence: 隨時（AWS re:Invent 約 12 月初）
checkpoints.supports_if: Amazon, AWS or Marvell confirms that Marvell designs or supplies a next-generation Trainium chip (Trainium3, Trainium4 or later), or Marvell says revenue from its lead XPU program keeps growing in fiscal 2028 and beyond. Unnamed supply-chain sources or analyst notes alone: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: Amazon, AWS, Alchip or Marvell confirms that another company, such as Alchip, leads the design of next-generation Trainium instead of Marvell, Marvell's filings show Amazon is no longer its largest customer, or Marvell says revenue from its lead XPU program will decline. Unnamed supply-chain sources or analyst notes alone: answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: scale-up 光學：從幾乎零營收到明年數億美元
checkpoints.cadence: 隨時（OFC 光通訊年會約 3 月中）
checkpoints.supports_if: Marvell raises its outlook for scale-up optics revenue or announces hyperscaler production orders for NPO or CPO used to link accelerators inside a rack, or a hyperscaler or NVIDIA confirms that accelerator-to-accelerator (scale-up) links move from copper to optics in systems shipping in 2027. Demos, samples or conference presentations without production orders: answer unrelated. Co-packaged optics used only in scale-out network switches: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: Marvell lowers its scale-up optics outlook or says customer deployments slip beyond 2027, major hyperscalers or NVIDIA say their next-generation scale-up links stay on copper, or a competitor is confirmed to have won the main scale-up optics orders at the top U.S. hyperscalers. Demos or samples alone: answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: 光 DSP 與 1.6T：互連成長跑贏資本支出、份額守住
checkpoints.supports_if: Marvell says its interconnect or electro-optics revenue grew faster than hyperscaler capex for two consecutive quarters, or reports hyperscaler production ramps of its 1.6T or 3.2T optical DSPs ahead of competitors. A single quarter's figure without a stated trend: answer neutral. Optical module makers' results that do not say whose DSP they use: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: Marvell says interconnect growth fell below hyperscaler capex growth for two consecutive quarters or reports optical DSP price pressure hurting margins, a competitor such as Broadcom or Credo confirms winning a large share of 1.6T optical DSP volume at the top U.S. hyperscalers, or hyperscalers confirm a large shift to linear pluggable optics that need no DSP. A single quarter's figure without a stated trend: answer neutral.

checkpoints.label: 毛利率：客製放量下連兩季守住 57.5%
checkpoints.cadence: 每季（下次財報約 12 月初）
checkpoints.supports_if: Marvell reports non-GAAP gross margin at or above 57.5% for two consecutive quarters, or reiterates that fiscal 2028 gross margin stays in the same range as the second half of fiscal 2027. A single quarter alone: answer neutral.
checkpoints.refutes_if: Marvell reports non-GAAP gross margin below 57.0% for two consecutive quarters, or lowers its gross margin guidance citing pricing pressure rather than product mix. A single quarter alone without a guidance change: answer neutral.

checkpoints.label: 四大雲端 2027 年資本支出指引：Marvell 模型的總前提
checkpoints.cadence: 每季（四大雲端財報約 10 月底、1 月底）
checkpoints.supports_if: Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon or Meta raise capital expenditure guidance, or their guidance for 2027 implies combined capex growth of roughly 30% or more. Analyst estimates alone: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon or Meta cut capital expenditure guidance, or their guidance for 2027 implies combined capex flat or down from 2026. Analyst estimates alone: answer unrelated.

due.label: 微軟、Alphabet、Meta、亞馬遜第三季財報
四大雲端第四季財報與 2027 年資本支出指引

checkpoints.label: scale-up 交換器：UALink、ESUN 與 100T 交換器出貨時程
checkpoints.supports_if: Marvell or a hyperscaler confirms Marvell's UALink or Ethernet (ESUN) scale-up switches entering volume production in 2027, or Marvell reports switch revenue above a $1 billion annual run rate with its 100T Teralynx switch winning hyperscaler designs. Product announcements or samples without customer production: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: Marvell says its UALink or ESUN scale-up switch slipped beyond 2027 or lost its lead customer, or hyperscalers confirm choosing other vendors' scale-up switches (Broadcom, NVIDIA, Astera Labs) for next-generation systems instead of Marvell's. Product announcements alone: answer unrelated.

ideas.title: 軟體重新分價：不是退訂潮，是座位制往用量制移、錢往推論與資安流

checkpoints.label: 按人頭收費的軟體：座位數與淨營收留存
checkpoints.cadence: 每季（HubSpot 11 月初、Salesforce 12 月初財報）
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports seat-based software companies seeing fewer seats or license reductions because customers use AI or build in-house tools, or an industry benchmark shows median net revenue retention for seat-based SaaS staying below 100%. A single data point without a stated trend or company statement is not enough: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports industry benchmarks showing seat-based SaaS net revenue retention back above 100%, or major software companies saying AI is not reducing seats and seat growth is accelerating. A single data point without a stated trend or company statement is not enough: answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: 龍頭能不能把座位換成用量：AI 代理營收與非座位計價占比
checkpoints.cadence: 每季（ServiceNow 10 月下旬、Microsoft 10 月底、Salesforce 12 月初財報）
checkpoints.supports_if: The company reports AI agent product revenue (Agentforce ARR, ServiceNow AI ACV, Copilot) still growing, a rising share of non-seat or consumption-based pricing, and total revenue growth holding or accelerating.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The company reports AI agent product revenue stalling, weak renewals of AI agent contracts, a return to seat-only pricing, or total revenue growth slowing alongside seat declines.

checkpoints.label: 中小企業自建取代：軟體公司說的流失原因
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports software companies or surveys explicitly saying customers cancelled subscriptions because they built their own tools with AI, or small-business customer churn rising for that reason.
checkpoints.refutes_if: SMB-focused software companies report churn flat or falling and do not mention customers replacing them with self-built AI tools.

checkpoints.label: 消費者訂閱：預算往 AI 移，不是總額下降
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports total consumer subscription spending still growing, with AI-related subscriptions growing fastest or taking a larger share.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports total consumer subscription spending declining year over year for three straight months.

checkpoints.label: 資安：自建軟體帶來的漏洞與資安支出
checkpoints.cadence: 每季（Cloudflare 11 月初、Palo Alto 11 月中、CrowdStrike 12 月初財報）
checkpoints.supports_if: Research or vendor data shows vulnerabilities or data exposures in AI-generated or vibe-coded software still increasing, or a security vendor says AI-written code is driving demand.
checkpoints.refutes_if: Major security vendors report demand slowing without citing any effect from AI-generated code.

due.label: Palo Alto FY27 第一季財報

checkpoints.label: 電網成本由誰付：資料中心負載與住宅電價
checkpoints.cadence: 每月（EIA 短期能源展望）
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports residential electricity prices or grid capacity costs rising and attributed to data center demand, or regulators adding large-load tariffs that make data centers pay more.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports grid capacity prices falling significantly, or forecasts of data center electricity demand being cut.

due.label: EIA 短期能源展望（11 月）

checkpoints.label: 工作：入門職缺減少，資深與驗證需求增加
checkpoints.supports_if: Job data shows entry-level software postings or early-career employment still falling while senior, AI or security roles grow.
checkpoints.refutes_if: Job data shows entry-level software hiring rebounding broadly and growing in line with senior roles.

ideas.title: AI 硬體：Nvidia 替明年四分之一的需求墊錢

checkpoints.label: OpenAI 的錢：下一輪募資、上市、算力合約有沒有縮
checkpoints.cadence: 隨時（2027 年第一季前後下一輪募資）
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports OpenAI closing a new funding round or tender offer at a flat or higher valuation, filing for an IPO on schedule, or its compute contracts with Oracle, Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom, Microsoft or the Stargate / SB Energy sites proceeding at full size or expanding. It also counts when OpenAI revenue growth is unaffected by Anthropic and its fundraising proceeds smoothly. A single data point without a stated trend, guidance change, or company statement is not enough: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports OpenAI delaying or failing to close a funding round or IPO, raising money at a lower valuation, or renegotiating, shrinking, postponing or failing to pay for compute contracts or data center projects (Stargate, SB Energy, Oracle, Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom). It also counts when Anthropic enterprise adoption keeps leading OpenAI and OpenAI fundraising terms get worse. A single data point without a stated trend, guidance change, or company statement is not enough: answer unrelated.

due.label: OpenAI 上一輪募資滿一年（下一輪募資或上市）

checkpoints.label: Nvidia 存貨、應收、供應承諾與保證
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports Nvidia's inventory growing more slowly than revenue, its supply and capacity purchase commitments flat or growing in line with revenue, and no new inventory write-downs or losses on guarantees it has given to customers or partners. A single data point without a stated trend, guidance change, or company statement is not enough: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports Nvidia taking an inventory write-down or charge, cancelling or renegotiating supply commitments, a further rise in days sales outstanding or longer customer payment terms, or a guarantee or backstop Nvidia gave (for example to SB Energy, CoreWeave or other AI clouds) being called or drawn. A single data point without a stated trend, guidance change, or company statement is not enough: answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: 四大雲 2027 資本支出 vs 營運現金流
checkpoints.cadence: 每季（10 月底 Q3 財報）
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta or Oracle guiding 2027 capital expenditures up 20% or more year over year while operating cash flow still covers the spending. A single data point without a stated trend, guidance change, or company statement is not enough: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports one of these companies guiding 2027 capital expenditures up less than 20%, or using words like digest, pause or moderate about AI spending, or two or more of Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Meta reporting negative free cash flow. A single data point without a stated trend, guidance change, or company statement is not enough: answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: Oracle、CoreWeave 與 neocloud 的債信
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports Oracle, CoreWeave or other AI cloud / neocloud companies' bond spreads or credit default swap spreads narrowing, new bonds or loans oversubscribed, or credit ratings affirmed. A single data point without a stated trend, guidance change, or company statement is not enough: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports Oracle cut to junk, CoreWeave or another neocloud's credit default swaps staying above about 1,000 basis points, a failed or pulled bond or loan deal, a covenant breach, missed payment, default or debt restructuring. A single data point without a stated trend, guidance change, or company statement is not enough: answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: 記憶體：合約價、長約執行、客戶庫存
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports DRAM or HBM contract prices still rising or flat quarter over quarter, and memory makers' long-term take-or-pay agreements and customer prepayments being honored or extended. A single data point without a stated trend, guidance change, or company statement is not enough: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports DRAM or HBM contract prices falling quarter over quarter, long-term memory supply agreements being renegotiated or cancelled, customer memory inventory above about eight weeks, or double ordering unwinding. A single data point without a stated trend, guidance change, or company statement is not enough: answer unrelated.

due.label: 美光 FQ1 FY27 財報

checkpoints.label: 2027 供給到位：HBM4 良率、Rubin 放量、新廠、CoWoS 產能
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports chip, memory or equipment suppliers (TSMC, ASML, Micron, SK Hynix, Applied Materials, Lam Research) still saying 2027 and 2028 supply will be tight, with new fabs, HBM4 and CoWoS capacity and the Nvidia Vera Rubin ramp on schedule. A single data point without a stated trend, guidance change, or company statement is not enough: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports a credible forecast of AI chip or memory oversupply in 2027, prices falling as new capacity comes online, or a further delay of the Vera Rubin ramp that leaves a gap in shipments. A single data point without a stated trend, guidance change, or company statement is not enough: answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: GPU 二手價、租金與抵押品
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports one-year H100 GPU rental contract prices flat or rising, or used GPU resale prices and residual values holding steady. A single data point without a stated trend, guidance change, or company statement is not enough: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports GPU rental rates falling more than about 30% within three months, used GPU resale price indexes down more than about 30% year over year, lenders cutting loan-to-value on GPU-backed loans, or GPU collateral being seized or sold. A single data point without a stated trend, guidance change, or company statement is not enough: answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: neocloud 專案貸款：利差、成數、合約年限
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports CoreWeave or another neocloud closing new secured, project or delayed-draw term loan financings at spreads similar to or tighter than earlier facilities (around SOFR plus 5.5% or less), with advance rates around 70% of GPU cost, or lenders still accepting two- to three-year customer contracts as collateral. High unsecured bond yields alone do not count as refuting. A single data point without a stated trend, guidance change, or company statement is not enough: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports new secured or project loans for CoreWeave or another neocloud priced clearly wider than SOFR plus 5.5%, lower advance rates or loan-to-value, lenders requiring more equity or parent guarantees, short customer contracts no longer accepted as collateral, or a secured financing delayed, downsized or pulled. A single data point without a stated trend, guidance change, or company statement is not enough: answer unrelated.

ideas.title: 美債 3～5 年展望：債券腿留在 IEF，不換長債

checkpoints.label: 股債是否回到反向：美股回檔時，公債是否上漲
checkpoints.cadence: 隨時（美股回檔 10% 以上時）
checkpoints.supports_if: During a new US stock decline of roughly 10% or more from a recent high (S&P 500 or Nasdaq), the news reports US Treasuries rising and yields falling on growth worries or expected Fed rate cuts; or new data or research shows the US stock-bond correlation has turned negative and stayed negative for about two months or more. A routine daily market wrap, or a single day's move without a decline of that size: answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: During a new US stock decline of roughly 10% or more from a recent high, the news reports US Treasuries falling (yields rising) alongside stocks for most of the decline, so bonds failed to offset stock losses. Reports that only restate that the stock-bond correlation is currently positive, or studies describing past periods (such as the Fed's October 2026 note on government bonds' safe-haven property), are not new evidence: answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: 通膨預期是否定錨：10 年通膨補償與 5 年後 5 年
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports US market-based long-term inflation expectations staying anchored: the 10-year breakeven inflation rate within about 2.2% to 2.6% and the 5-year, 5-year forward breakeven below 2.6%; or University of Michigan 5-10 year inflation expectations declining for a second straight month.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports the 5-year, 5-year forward breakeven above 2.8% for about a month or more, University of Michigan 5-10 year inflation expectations above 3.9% (above the May 2026 high), or Fed officials saying long-term inflation expectations are no longer anchored. Short-term (1-year) expectations alone, or a single day's breakeven move: answer unrelated.

due.label: 密大 10 月終值（含通膨預期）
密大 11 月初值（含通膨預期）

checkpoints.label: 聯準會資產負債表：何時停止縮表、是否開始買短券
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports the Federal Reserve announcing or clearly signaling an end to, or a slowdown of, balance sheet runoff (quantitative tightening), or the start of Treasury bill purchases (reserve management purchases), reducing the amount of Treasuries the private market must absorb.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports the Fed announcing a faster balance sheet runoff or higher monthly runoff caps, or Fed officials discussing outright sales of its Treasury holdings. Runoff continuing at the current pace, weekly balance sheet data, or decisions only about the policy interest rate (covered by a separate checkpoint): answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: 外資與日本資金：外資是否持續淨買長期美債
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports Treasury International Capital (TIC) data showing foreign investors as net buyers of long-term US Treasuries for a third straight month or more, or Japanese investors or life insurers increasing purchases of US Treasuries.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports TIC data showing foreign net selling of US Treasuries for two straight months, or Japanese life insurers or pension funds publicly announcing a shift of money from foreign bonds back to Japanese government bonds. A change in one country's holdings alone (for example only China): answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: 聯準會獨立性與人事
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports a court or the Senate blocking a White House attempt to remove or replace a Federal Reserve governor, or the Fed raising or holding interest rates in line with inflation data despite public White House pressure to cut. Routine Fed commentary without a political-pressure angle, or rate decisions without such pressure (covered by a separate checkpoint): answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports a Fed rate cut widely described as driven by political pressure, or the removal or forced resignation of a Fed governor, while long-term Treasury yields rise.

checkpoints.label: 黃金腿是否在財政情境補位
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports gold hitting record highs while long-term US Treasury yields rise or the dollar weakens, or central bank gold purchases holding steady or rising in quarterly data such as World Gold Council reports.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports gold falling more than about 5% together with stocks during a new equity selloff, or central bank gold purchases declining for a second consecutive quarter.

checkpoints.label: 美元趨勢：殖利率升時美元是否同升
checkpoints.supports_if: The news reports the US dollar rising together with US Treasury yields, with higher yields attracting buyers to the dollar.
checkpoints.refutes_if: The news reports the US dollar weakening for weeks while US Treasury yields rise, described as investors selling US assets (a 'sell America' trade), worries about the dollar's reserve-currency status, or de-dollarization. A single day's currency move: answer unrelated.

ideas.title: 亞洲資金大撤退：不是 1997，壓力在 AI 借錢與外資撤出台股

checkpoints.label: 東北亞會不會出現 1997 式特徵：台韓外匯存底、本幣、資本管制
checkpoints.cadence: 每月（央行月初公布外匯存底）
company_names: central bank of the republic of china
checkpoints.supports_if: Official data show Taiwan or South Korea foreign exchange reserves stable (monthly decline within 3%), short-term external debt well below reserves, no capital controls, and no monthly currency fall above 10% against the dollar. A single opinion piece, forecast or one-day move without official data → answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: Taiwan or South Korea reports a monthly drop in foreign exchange reserves above 5%, its currency falls more than 10% against the dollar in a month, or the central bank imposes capital controls or seeks IMF support. A single opinion piece, forecast or one-day move without official data → answer unrelated.

due.label: 台灣央行公布 10 月底外匯存底

checkpoints.label: 台股補跌與融資：外資賣超、融資餘額、台積電
checkpoints.cadence: 每日（證交所 21:30 前後公布融資）
checkpoints.supports_if: Taiwan stocks fall 15% or more from the October high with margin balances starting to shrink, or foreign investors keep net selling while margin debt still rises; or hyperscalers cut 2027 capex or TSMC lowers its outlook. A single opinion piece, forecast or one-day move without official data → answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: Taiwan's TAIEX makes a new high with foreign investors turning to sustained net buying and margin balances not making new highs; or hyperscalers raise 2027 capex and TSMC raises its full-year outlook. A single opinion piece, forecast or one-day move without official data → answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: 台灣壽險與台幣：錯配還在、方向是怕升
checkpoints.cadence: 每季（金管會壽險統計）；台幣急變時
checkpoints.supports_if: Taiwan life insurers keep hedge ratios below about 50% and do not shrink overseas assets, or a sharp Taiwan dollar rise causes larger FX losses or reserve drawdowns at insurers. A single opinion piece, forecast or one-day move without official data → answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: Taiwan life insurers sharply raise hedge ratios or cut overseas assets so the currency mismatch disappears, or a Taiwan dollar slump causes liquidity problems at insurers. A single opinion piece, forecast or one-day move without official data → answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: 南韓：記憶體雙雄、外資賣超與散戶融資
checkpoints.cadence: 每日；三星、SK 海力士財報
checkpoints.supports_if: Foreign investors keep net selling Korean stocks, margin or credit balances fall further, KOSPI stays below its 52-week average, or memory contract prices weaken. A single opinion piece, forecast or one-day move without official data → answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: Foreign investors turn to sustained net buying of Korean stocks, KOSPI regains and holds its 52-week average for weeks, or memory contract prices rise again. A single opinion piece, forecast or one-day move without official data → answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: 東南亞與印度：1997 條件最接近的地方會不會外溢
checkpoints.supports_if: Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand or India face currency pressure and respond with rate hikes or intervention, while Taiwan and South Korea markets and currencies do not fall in step. A single opinion piece, forecast or one-day move without official data → answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: One of these countries has a 1997-style crisis (reserves collapsing, capital controls, IMF program) and Taiwan and South Korea stocks and currencies fall sharply at the same time. A single opinion piece, forecast or one-day move without official data → answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: 日本利率正常化：日圓套利與資金回流
checkpoints.cadence: 日銀會議；每月財務省資料
checkpoints.supports_if: 30-year JGB yields stay near or above 4%, Japanese insurers and pension funds add domestic bonds, or Japanese net purchases of foreign securities slow. A single opinion piece, forecast or one-day move without official data → answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: Japanese investors keep buying foreign securities heavily despite JGB yields above 3%, or a yen carry unwind lifts the yen more than 8% in a month and triggers a global equity selloff. A single opinion piece, forecast or one-day move without official data → answer unrelated.

checkpoints.label: 亞洲退休基金的海外配置與避險
checkpoints.cadence: 每季（各基金公告）；年度配置計畫
checkpoints.supports_if: South Korea's NPS, Japan's GPIF or Taiwan's labor funds keep overseas allocation flat or lower, or raise currency hedging. A single opinion piece, forecast or one-day move without official data → answer unrelated.
checkpoints.refutes_if: These funds keep raising overseas allocation targets and cut currency hedging. A single opinion piece, forecast or one-day move without official data → answer unrelated.
